order_reference.description: Order code from the confirmation email link or order page URL, e.g. "o_AbC123…". (The short "Order Number" like O-XXXXX cannot be looked up.)

include_past.description: Set true to search past events instead of upcoming ones.

actions.description: Register the visitor for "WebMCP Community Workshop" (the event on this page; no event_id needed) by placing a real ticket order through the site's own checkout. THIS PLACES AN ORDER — call only after the user asked to register and confirmed ticket type, quantity and their name/email. Free tickets complete immediately: the order is confirmed and the page navigates to the order confirmation. Paid tickets reserve the order with the visitor's selections and navigate to the site's payment step, where the user pays (the agent never handles payment). If the ticket type is sold out but the organizer runs a waitlist, the visitor is added to the waitlist instead (using their name/email) and notified by email if a spot opens — nothing is charged. If it is sold out with no waitlist, or the quantity is unavailable, nothing happens and the response says why. Returns the order reference or waitlist status and next step.
